page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a rule-bounded table of two rows. Below it, a running text of two paragraphs, a second table with labels at left, a summa row, and a closing paragraph ending in a catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Hifce tabulis præmiffis, redeundū nobis eft ad pro-pofitum exemplum, & quomodo characteres hebdomadici cum horis & scrupulis appendicibus fint inuestigandi est consideran-dum. Neomenia Tifri anni mundi 5349 naturaliter cœpit feria quarta hora tertia, scrupulo 542, quod ostenditur ex annis elapsis 5348, qui conficiunt enneadecaeterides 81, & 9 annos: hisce annis oportet ex tabulis depromere conuenientes characteres, eosq; in summa vna [?]contrahere, & tandem Radicem adiicere, vt ex sequnti praxi apparet.

Scrupula 1622 suppeditant horam vnam, remaneant 542 scrupula: hora ista si adiiciatur a[?]68 horas, fiunt 69 horae, quae efficiunt duos dies, & 21 horas: sed ex 21 horis abiiciendae sunt horae pro integro die numerandae, & superfunt 3 horae: quare integrum triduum adiiciendum est ad 1 dies, & consurgit summa octodecim dierum, ex quibus si septenarij abiiciatur, remanet character hebdomadicus, qui est feria quarta: cui si addantur appendices horarum & scrupulorum, ostenditur inde neomeniae

page.notes: The table of Dies, Hora and Scrupula is read cell by cell; the Scrupula column values 6 and 53 are doubtful, and the column total 522 does not match the visible entries. "a68" may be "ad 68", so it is marked. The first word of the first table row is blank in the print. The "ontrahere" at the start of a word is partly lost in the scan and is marked. The word "pro-" is hyphenated at the line end in the first paragraph. Catchword "Tifri" stands alone at the foot right.
